This '''butterfly''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Antares system/Legends|Antares system]]. A [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Butterfly/Legends|butterfly]], it could deliver a deadly nerve [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] through its stinger. Although the species had been extinct in its native habitat for over fifty years, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] spotted one in the [[Garden of Butterflies]] in [[New Escrow]]. Due to his identification, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] determined the creature was actually [[Darth Vader's secretary]], a shapeshifter attempting to assassinate Viscount [[Tardi]]. At her command, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] downed the faux insect with flame retardant, and she promptly crushed it underfoot.<ref name="marvel48" />
